source.promptText: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent 2D game character cuff-and-hand sprite. Input image is the EDIT TARGET and style reference: the original DeepSeek whale maid's far hand and white ruffled cuff. Create a clean enlarged replacement for ONLY this cuff and hand, on genuine transparent alpha, keeping the same cute chibi anatomy, pale peach skin, very dark indigo outlines, white scalloped cuff, simple cel shading, proportions and three-quarter back-of-hand viewpoint. One small hand, no arm except a tiny dark navy sleeve attachment above the cuff; no character, no prop, no shadow, no checkerboard, no labels or text. Keep the wrist at the top leaning slightly left, fingers extending down and slightly right, same orientation as reference. Preserve a readable continuous cuff silhouette with generous clear margin. Output one centered upright sprite on a square canvas, cuff at upper center, hand below. Finger pose: an open reaching hand ready to touch a seashell, four short rounded fingers gently extended and slightly separated, thumb opening to the left. Make it clearly open, delicate and relaxed, not a fist, not waving. The cuff is identical to the reference, do not add jewelry. The empty grasp region is below the palm near the fingertips. No visible object.
